source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This later CSS phase removes root not-lwtheme guards from positive prefers-contrast branches. It preserves separate conditions, including the noncontrast not-lwtheme branch and the minimonth light-theme ancestor rule. The owned button edit also changes nesting/order: its contrast-hover border sits before the nested active override. Read media, theme and local state together; this patch is not permission to remove every theme guard or proof that all cascades are equivalent. Selected accepted source keeps contrast scope, but no computed style or platform/theme check ran.
title: Removing the contrast theme guard leaves other theme and state conditions intact
